title: Lane brief and lane run take base, commands and task from the repo contract
body:
Why: lane fetches origin/main, requires tasks/<id>.json and briefs npm run fast and node scripts/claude/worker-stop.ts (src/cli/lane.ts:40,141-144,303-306); 26 origin/main literals in src/.
Outcome: lane uses the contract base branch and fast/test commands in the brief; a task id is optional when the contract tracker is none (brief text from --goal).
Proof: lane brief unit test on a contract with base master, pytest and no tracker.
Scope: src/cli/, src/repo/, test/.
